# dsh-sound-cue

A sound cue plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI: it plays a short sound
when a turn finishe

s, and a different alert when something waits for you (an
approval, a question, a plan review), so y
ou can look away while the agent works.
## Install

From this repository, into a DSH profile (`desktop` in the desktop app, `web`
for the Web CLI):
[代码示例省略，未执行]

DSH checks GitHub with `git ls-remote` before installing, so that form needs Git.
Without Git, insta
ll the release tarball instead — it skips the Git check:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The same specs work in the app through the plugin manager (Settings → Plugins →
install by spec). Af

ter installing, open a conversation: the 🔔 chip sits under
the composer.
## What it does

ntion** — its own sound, independent of the completion cue: by default a
fixed three-note alert (low

er for approvals, higher for questions), or any
built-in tone / your own audio file, so a prompt tha

t needs an answer is
recognisable without looking.
- Entry point: a small bell chip under the conver

sation composer. Clicking it
opens a floating panel above the chip (rendered by the frame-wide overl

ay, so
the conversation layout never shifts), with the switches (master, always-on
listener, attenti

on alert), the sound picker, volume, preview, and an
attention-alert preview. Click outside or press

Escape to dismiss it. The panel
grows to fit its content in the space above the chip; only when the

viewport is
too short does it scroll, with a permanently visible scrollbar.
- Always-on listener: w

hen *Keep listening on other pages* is on, cues are driven
by the client-wide session status map (`r

unning`, `pendingInteraction`) instead
of the conversation view, so they still fire while Settings,

the plugin market,
or another panel is open. The composer chip stays silent in that mode so a
single

turn never produces two cues.
- Built-in tones: chime, bell, marimba, pop, ding (synthesized with W

ebAudio,
no audio assets shipped).
- Custom tone: choose any `audio/*` file (stored as a data URL in

this browser's
`localStorage`, 3 MB limit) — separately for the completion cue and the
attention cu

e.
- Switches: master, always-on listener, attention alert; plus two sound pickers
(completion / att
ention), volume, and both previews.
Settings key: `dsh-sound-cue:settings`.
## Slots

- `conversation.composer.dock` / `sound-cue` (order 20) — composer chip.
- `shell.overlay` / `sound-

cue:resident` (order 40) — headless always-on
listener.
- `shell.overlay` / `sound-cue:popover` (ord
er 41) — floating settings panel.
## Development

- The package is plain ESM with no build step: `index.js` is the host entry,
`client.js` is the brow

ser bundle loaded through `window.__ModuleLoader__`,
and `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the `sound-cue`

row.
- A local profile can link this folder (`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-sound-cue`)

,
so editing `client.js` takes effect without reinstalling.
- `dev/smoke.test.mjs` loads the real `c

lient.js` in a sandbox with a fake React
runtime, WebAudio and `localStorage`, and checks the cue an

d panel behaviour:
`node dev/smoke.test.mjs` (any Node.js 20+).
